column1: # USB Ethernet/tethering corpus, seed. Source: usb.ids 2026.06.26 (hwdata), device names matching an Ethernet/tether filter for the listed vendors.
# Unweighted, not market share. `interfaces` (class/subclass/protocol list, ';'-separated, e.g. 02/06/00;0a/00/00) is empty because usb.ids does not
# carry it: such rows can only match the vendor-specific id table, so class-compliant CDC-ECM/NCM and RNDIS devices are undercounted.
# Apple devices (iPhone tethering, crates/imobiledevice) are not counted here. `test` is the highest level that actually passed.
# `weight` is a popularity count (0 = unknown). No public popularity data for USB network adapters was found, so every row is 0 and USB figures are unweighted.
